name: bollinger_ema_sar_v2_robustness
purpose: Test whether the V2 non-lateral slope result is stable without changing any entry, stop, target, pattern, structure, session, or indicator rule.

parameter_perturbation.purpose: Robustness plateau only; do not pick the best threshold from this discovery window.

temporal_checks: first half vs second half of discovery window

monte_carlo.method: moving-block bootstrap of chronological trade net-R sequence

decision_rule: This stage may reject instability but may not authorize live trading, open confirmatory data, or unseal the final holdout.
